Lakeside Community Center — Fall Class Schedule (Sept. 8–Nov. 28)

Monday
6:00–7:00 P.M. Beginner Spanish (Room 2) — $60

Tuesday
10:00–11:00 A.M. Gentle Stretching for Seniors (Gym) — Free for members 65+
7:00–8:30 P.M. Digital Photography (Computer Lab) — $75, bring your own camera

Wednesday
4:00–5:00 P.M. Kids' Art Club, ages 6–10 (Room 3) — $50, supplies included

Thursday
6:30–8:00 P.M. Home Cooking Basics (Kitchen) — $90, includes ingredients

Each class meets once a week for 12 weeks. Center members receive 10% off all paid classes.
Registration opens August 25 online or at the front desk. Classes with fewer than five students by September 1 may be canceled.

questions.stem: Which class requires students to provide their own equipment?
questions.explanation: Digital Photography lists "bring your own camera." The art and cooking classes include supplies and ingredients.

questions.stem: What is indicated about the stretching class?
options: A. It is held in the evening.
B. It takes place in the kitchen.
C. It is designed for children.
D. Some participants do not pay for it.
questions.explanation: Gentle Stretching for Seniors is "Free for members 65+."

questions.stem: What will most likely happen to a class that has only three students on September 1?
options: A. It may not take place.
B. It will be moved to another room.
C. It will be offered for free.
D. It will start on August 25.
questions.explanation: "Classes with fewer than five students by September 1 may be canceled."
